cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import os
tot=0; entries=0
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('submission'):
    entries += len(dirs)+len(files)
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(root,f)
        tot += os.path.getsize(p)
print('entries (files+dirs):', entries, 'bytes:', tot)
" && python3 /tmp/bench2.py
